exposure: Pregnant women with prior cesarean section but no CSP
Presence of a uterine-fundal hypoechoic mass
outcome: Presence of a uterine-fundal hypoechoic mass
cohort: Fourteen women treated for cesarean scar pregnancy at a single tertiary institute over a period of ten years, and pregnant women with prior cesarean section but no CSP
finding: Patients with CSP more frequently had a uterine-fundal hypoechoic mass, whose detection may trigger a detailed observation of the CSP site, possibly leading to CSP diagnosis.
